ir.intuition: Reference builder: all winner/loser pairs by objective ordering.

ir.name: pairwise_sigmoid_advantage_loss_sum_clamped
ir.intuition: Shift aggregation from mean to sum to emphasize total loss magnitude with explicit clipping to ensure numeric stability when combining logits and advantage signals.
ir.pseudocode:
margin = lpw - lpl - beta * advantage_gap
clamped_margin = clamp(margin, -clip_val, clip_val)
losses = -log(sigmoid(alpha * clamped_margin))
loss = sum(weight * losses)
ir.code:
def generated_loss(batch, model_output, extra):
    lpw = batch['log_prob_w']
    lpl = batch['log_prob_l']
    weight = batch.get('weight', None)
    adv = batch['advantage_gap']
    alpha = float(extra.get('alpha', extra.get('hyperparams', {}).get('alpha', 1.0)))
    beta = float(extra.get('beta', extra.get('hyperparams', {}).get('beta', 0.5)))
    clip_val = float(extra.get('clip_val', extra.get('hyperparams', {}).get('clip_val', 10.0)))
    margin_raw = ops.sub(lpw, lpl)
    margin = ops.sub(margin_raw, ops.mul(beta, adv))
    clamped_margin = ops.clamp(margin, -clip_val, clip_val)
    scaled = ops.mul(alpha, clamped_margin)
    losses = ops.neg(ops.logsigmoid(scaled))
    if weight is not None:
        losses = ops.mul(losses, weight)
    return ops.sum(losses)
